description: Original F CROSS_RX50 scratch33L+17U retained. Current same paired RDrop L CE weak1/3 gradient contributions, block symmetric PCGrad-inspired coordination vs original Lidentity direction with counterfactual matching perblock Lidentity norm. No new forwards/parameters/head fit. No satellite;clean only.
authorization: Active user weak-transmitter feature-learning goal. Original F+crossRX sameTX baseline; local; no satellite; clean only; existing default head joint. Source-fixed weakTX1/3; no target-based tuning.

roles.U_s: 56700 TX hidden; original U256 and batch_neighbor/ownEMA recipe during17U epochs; no new U feature objective
roles.V: 27000 no_grad defaulthead health plus descriptive actual joint160 source geometry. No V gradient/statistic in training, head fit, prototype classification, or target use.

notes: Original F CROSS_RX50=33L+17U/11100updates, RDrop1/ordinaryAug/LS.01/oldgate-ownEMA-cos/unified physical Sinc/defaultheadjoint. No satellite; clean168000 only. Physical GPU0 max3 global GPU workers across owners and freeRAM>=4.5GiB; independentCPU scorermax1. Preserve healthy tasks.

Prior full-sourceL gradients of original3BASEfinal50: weakTX1vs3 pooled featureCE cosine negative3/3. This is frozen clean/eval diagnostic; not actual RDrop/U/AdamW update or target proof. Prior RX-risk and metaRX negatives retained; new grouping weak1/3 differs historical RX CAGrad on single SIG_TIME.

Per-class CE contribution uses the two ORIGINAL stochastic L128 logits, averaged per sample and summed class/128 with LS.01. No class upweight, U truth, V gradient, extra IQ/model forward, params or optimizer steps. gL is current Lidentity RDrop+original shallow/mid crossRX SupCon, not full native loss or U.

Every4steps after warm5: first1112,last11100,2498scheduled; strength epoch6=.1 to epoch15=1. Three extra full-feature VJP each eligible event, <=7494/model. On block ga dot gb<0, simultaneous a_prime=a-dot(a,b)/norm(b)^2*b and b_prime=b-dot(a,b)/norm(a)^2*a. BLOCK_PAIR adds eta*(a_prime+b_prime-a-b). NORM_L_ID uses original gL direction scaled to match norm(gL+delta) perblock at same state. No conflict/zero gL/zero weak/missing weak => no correction. Equal opposing vectors cancel exactly. No guarantee actual AdamW descent; U/aux gradients then summed and original physicalclip5 applies.

Full deployed id_backbone features excluding actual default cls_head, including response and all3 SIG_TIME views. Zero-valued linear surrogate carries detached feature correction only; unused None leaves remain None to avoid activating AdamW decay. Direct default W auxiliary gradient None; mainhead joint unchanged before global clip, which may affect W final scale.

Sinc module only common-scale low_coordinate/band_coordinate leaves: projection coefficients and perblock norm ratio invariant under common s=25000 scaling. Do not multiply historical factors again. Original CENTER_UNITS physical Hz globalclip5/AdamW including origin decay remains.

Initial seed01 both source complete, each weak outRX marginq10>=BASE+.002 and RXspread/gap<=1.05x, zero feature0; defaulthead overall>=-.2pp,worstRX>=-.5pp,anyTX>=-1pp;2498scheduled,eligible>=99%,nonzero>=10%. Fix expansion before any new candidate target summary. Failed source arms still clean-score initial rows; only qualified arm expands unchanged02/03.

Geometry uses existing no_grad V and raw actual joint160, no fitted head or prototype decisions. SourceRX all seen in training; outRX excludes RX from descriptive centroids only. Final50 fixed, scratchownEMA. Matching BASE scores/source reused without training/prediction or inheritedweights; one realcheckpoint noquerysmoke discarded.

Exposed exploratory Phase1 clean benchmark. Historical85.1139% method anchor only; local pairedBASE01/02/03 reference. Preserve all negatives and actualseed counts/sampleSD missingn1. No target-tuning/reseed/selection, independentblind,Phase2 or satellite claim.

Primary inspiration https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.06782 Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning. Fixed-class perblock symmetric adaptation with matched Lidentity norm control; not canonical full reproduction/new invention or guarantee.

REJECTED_EXTRA_GATE: generic design approval pause/full suite outside exclusive workflow; existing scoped user research authorization. Focusednegativechecks, one discarded realcheckpoint noquerysmoke, one independent P0/P1review.
